response.sql:
WITH funding_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    COUNT(*) AS qc_record_count
  FROM scanqc AS q
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT
  fundflux,
  qc_record_count,
  qc_record_count::numeric / SUM(qc_record_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
  qc_record_count::numeric / AVG(qc_record_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
FROM funding_counts;

assumptions.assumption: A missing fundflux value is grouped as SQL NULL, forming its own funding-source group.
